summary: Dependency pinned to mutable third-party GitHub ref executes at install time
details: package.json declares the dependency `libsignal` as `github:RahmadTenpoles/libsignal-node` with no commit SHA, tag, or integrity check. On `npm install`, npm fetches whatever bytes currently exist at HEAD of that third-party GitHub repository and runs any lifecycle scripts contained in that tree. The GitHub account hosting the dependency source is unrelated to the npm publisher of this package, so control of the install-time payload is delegated to a separate third party who can push new code to the repo at any time and have it executed on every subsequent install of raiden-baileys without any new release of this package. This is an off-registry, unpinned dependency source, which is the standard fingerprint of install-time code inclusion from an untrusted control sphere (CWE-829).

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
